typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCatalystPOQPendingTradesForCOBCurrent_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		NotSettledMorethan3days as integer,
		counterparty as string,
		cusip as string,
		isParentChild as string,
		Trading_Unit_Name as string,
		Desk_Name as string,
		Desk_ManagerName as string,
		isInternational as string,
		TicketNumber as string,
		EntryDate as string,
		TradeDate as string,
		SettleDate as string,
		TicketTypeCode as string,
		Entered_By as string,
		TraderName as string,
		Approved_By as string,
		PositionGroupDesc as string,
		TradeStatusString as string,
		Sales as string,
		Par as string,
		TradePrice as string,
		TotalCash as string,
		PreviousTicketNumber as string,
		Loaddate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> POQPending
POQPending derive({Copy of TradeDate} = toDate(TradeDate, "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of EntryDate} = toDate(EntryDate, "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		{Copy of Trading_Unit_Name} = Trading_Unit_Name,
		{Copy of Desk_ManagerName} = Desk_ManagerName,
		{Copy of Desk_Name} = Desk_Name,
		{Copy of SettleDate} = toDate(SettleDate, "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DataConversion1
DataConversion1 sink(input(
		Par as string,
		TraderName as string,
		Trading_Unit_Name as string,
		cusip as string,
		Entered_By as string,
		Approved_By as string,
		TradePrice as string,
		Desk_ManagerName as string,
		TradeStatusString as string,
		isParentChild as string,
		PositionGroupDesc as string,
		PreviousTicketNumber as string,
		Sales as string,
		isInternational as string,
		TicketNumber as string,
		TotalCash as string,
		Desk_Name as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		EntryDate as string,
		counterparty as string,
		TradeDate as string,
		NotSettledMorethan3days as string,
		SettleDate as string,
		TicketTypeCode as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Par,
		TraderName,
		Trading_Unit_Name = {Copy of Trading_Unit_Name},
		cusip,
		Entered_By,
		Approved_By,
		TradePrice,
		Desk_ManagerName = {Copy of Desk_ManagerName},
		TradeStatusString,
		isParentChild,
		PositionGroupDesc,
		PreviousTicketNumber,
		Sales,
		isInternational,
		TicketNumber,
		TotalCash,
		Desk_Name = {Copy of Desk_Name},
		Loaddate,
		EntryDate = {Copy of EntryDate},
		counterparty,
		TradeDate = {Copy of TradeDate},
		NotSettledMorethan3days,
		SettleDate = {Copy of SettleDate},
		TicketTypeCode),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCatalystPOQPendingTradesForCOBCurrent_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCatalystPOQPendingTradesForCOBCurrent
